description: This file defines the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page named AdminQueue, which manages admin operations related to course queues, session validation, and navigation in an online examination system.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue page handling page load, session validation, database interaction for course queue, and navigation control.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, checks session variables, interacts with database to verify course queue, and performs cleanup if necessary.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin panel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the same page, possibly to refresh or reload profile data.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection change in GridView, stores selected student and course IDs in session, and navigates to answer display page.
